subject: Provisional ingress barrier and prioritization checklist for NovaLite variants
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 9 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Provisional ingress barrier and prioritization checklist for NovaLite variants

Team —

Quick summary: NovaLite-3b variants failed two recent ingestion compatibility checks across our tokenizer/kv-path (see attached compat matrix). The failure surface looks intermittent, but given the number of customers on the NovaLite family (OrbitAI included), I recommend we put a provisional ingress barrier (temporary pin) on the affected variants while we triage.

Requests: 
- Product decision: confirm whether we enforce a temporary ingress block for nova-lite-3b/* variants (suggested duration: 2 weeks).
- Fallback policy: decide the default fallback variant for live traffic (proposal: nova-3b-stable).
- Telemetry gates: agree on the minimal telemetry set we need before unblocking (tokenizer mismatch rate, upstream error rate, latency P95).
- Roadmap impact: where should this sit on Q1 workstream (patch-first or rollback-first)?
- Owner & comms: identify the primary owner for customer outreach and for pushing a canary if we go that route.

Attachments: novalite-compat-matrix.csv, ingress-risk-summary.pdf — the matrix calls out failures for sequences >1024 and some KV cache mismatches.

My suggested immediate action: provisional ingress barrier, open a short-lived canary with nova-3b-stable in staging, and schedule a focused 1-hour triage with infra and tokens team tomorrow.

Karthik
Director, Model Ops
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 9 Jan 2027 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisional ingress barrier and prioritization checklist for NovaLite variants

Thanks Karthik —

I agree we should be cautious. A couple quick clarifying Qs: 
1) Do we have an estimate of customer impact (requests/min) if we block the variants? OrbitAI is on a dev sandbox for now, but if any production customers are pinned we should loop CS immediately.
2) Can we do a staging-only hold first so we don't disrupt any in-progress rollouts?

Proposal: staging-only provisional hold for 48 hours while infra runs focused tokenizer regression tests. If those pass, we open a canary with nova-3b-stable for 24 hours and monitor the telemetry gates Karthik listed.

Assigning action owners:
- Marissa: coordinate with CS and OrbitAI contact (Alyssa) for communication.
- Karthik: own triage with tokens/infra and confirm telemetry dashboards.

On Mon I can confirm whether product wants this escalated to a safety freeze or handled as an isolated ingress barrier.

Laura
PM, Deployments

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, alyssa@orbitai.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisional ingress barrier and prioritization checklist for NovaLite variants

Looping in what I promised during standup: here's a short mutual action plan (attached as MAP_NovaLite_v1.md). High level:
- T+0 (now): staging-only ingress hold on nova-lite-3b/*; create internal ticket INF-4521 and tag infra + tokens.
- T+1 (24h): run regression suite focused on tokenizer boundary cases and KV eviction patterns (infra).
- T+2 (48h): if regressions are cleared, open canary with nova-3b-stable to 5% of staging traffic for 24h.
- T+3: post-canary decision — if telemetry gates pass (tokenizer mismatch <0.5%, error rate delta <0.2pp, P95 latency within 10%) we lift the staging hold and begin a phased prod rollout.

Customer comms: Alyssa (OrbitAI) has been notified; she asked for an ETA on unblocking and prefers a weekly digest of status until resolved. I'll own comms and send the first update today EOD.

Notes: We will need a short SLA exception form filled if we extend the provisional barrier beyond 2 weeks — legal/contracts will need to weigh in (CC'ed contracts@octane-consulting.com).

Marissa
Head of Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisional ingress barrier and prioritization checklist for NovaLite variants

Thanks for the quick coordination. Approve the staging-only provisional ingress barrier and the MAP Marissa outlined. A few conditions before we lift any locks: 
- Create the JIRA INF-4521 with clear acceptance criteria and owners (Karthik to own triage; Infra lead to own regressions).
- Add a short remediation plan for any potential rollout fallout (rollback steps + runbook).
- If we need >2 weeks, escalate to me for SLA/contract review.

Karthik — please kick off the triage and confirm the telemetry dashboards are wired to the console. Marissa — thanks for owning customer comms; please share the first EOD digest with Alyssa and contracts@octane-consulting.com.

Vivek
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
